title: Gold Sequence Generator
text: Generate Gold sequence from set of sequences, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Preferred polynomial (1)} sets the first sequence polynomial, {Initial states (1)} sets the initial states for first sequence polynomial, {Preferred polynomial (2)} sets the second sequence polynomial, {Initial states (2)} sets the initial states for second sequence polynomial, {Sequence index}, {Shift} sets the offset of Gold sequence, {Output variable-size signals} sets the option to output variable-length signals, {Maximum output size source}, {Maximum output size}, {Sample time} sets the output sample time, {Samples per frame} and {Reset on nonzero input} sets the reset output signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: oSiz
ports.summary: Current output size scalar | two-element row vector

ports.name: Ref
ports.summary: Reference input signal scalar | column vector

params.name: Preferred polynomial (1)
params.values: First sequence polynomial ’z^6 + z + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | integer row vector

params.name: Initial states (1)
params.values: Initial states for first sequence polynomial [0 0 0 0 0 1] (default) | binary vector

params.name: Preferred polynomial (2)
params.values: Second sequence polynomial ’z^6 + z^5 + z^2 + z + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | integer row vector

params.name: Initial states (2)
params.values: Initial states for second sequence polynomial [0 0 0 0 0 1] (default) | binary vector

params.name: Sequence index
params.values: Sequence index 0 (default) | integer scalar in the range [–2, 2 n –2]

params.name: Shift
params.values: Offset of Gold sequence 0 (default) | integer scalar

params.name: Output variable-size signals
params.values: Option to output variable-length signals off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum output size source
params.values: Maximum output size source Dialog parameter (default) | Inherit from reference port

params.name: Maximum output size
params.values: Maximum output size [10 1] (default) | vector of the form [ n 1]

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | boolean | Smallest unsigned integer
